method: Compared lesson and checkpoint claims with registered OpenAI and Anthropic latency documentation, Anthropic streaming event documentation and the DistServe paper; executed the local boundary assertions and every Python fence. No provider request was made.

observations.trace: Retained the four historical rows as non-reproducible observations; removed fixed-rate and causal extrapolations; distinguished TTFT, first visible text, TPOT and task latency; added agent critical-path model and offline-only runnable examples.

limitations: Historical raw requests, responses, request IDs, endpoint/model fingerprints, per-event timestamps, repeated samples and scorer are unavailable; the 2026-10-09 observations were not rerun.
No live provider, production agent trace, browser rendering latency, SDK, billing, cache or workload-specific p95 was tested.
Offline boundary assertions verify editorial constraints, not production latency behavior.
